name: partner-statement
title: Packaging balance statement draft
for_each: select id,code from packaging.locations where kind='partner' order by code

sections.title: Recorded balance
sections.note: Reconcile against the partner record before sending. No statement is sent by this system.
sections.sql: select item,quantity,last_movement from packaging.balances where location_id=$1 order by item

sections.title: Unreturned issues
sections.sql: select reference,item,outstanding,due_on from packaging.returns_due where partner=(select code from packaging.locations where id=$1) order by due_on

name: movement-docket
title: Packaging movement docket
for_each: select id,reference from packaging.movements order by reference

sections.title: Recorded movement
sections.note: Operator-entered record, not proof of physical handover or an electronic signature.
sections.sql: select m.reference,m.moved_on,f.name origin,t.name destination,i.name item,m.quantity,m.evidence_ref,m.actor,m.note from packaging.movements m join packaging.locations f on f.id=m.from_id join packaging.locations t on t.id=m.to_id join packaging.items i on i.id=m.item_id where m.id=$1

name: count-reconciliation
title: Packaging count reconciliation
for_each: select id,location||'-'||item code from packaging.reconciliations order by location,item

sections.title: Count and ledger
sections.note: A variance does not change stock. Review the source and record an authorised correction separately.
